summary: Forecast run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202607302200_20260730213147 was issued at 2026-07-30T11:27:01Z and available at 2026-07-30T14:17:47Z (these timestamps are from the forecast run metadata).
For the half-hour ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z (2026-07-31 02:30 ACST) the run reports POE50 = 1525.0 MW, POE10 = 1619.0 MW and POE90 = 1430.0 MW (values from the run's returned rows).
compare_forecast_actual reports a mean absolute error (MAE) of 2.0 MW for paired targets available by 2026-07-30T14:35:00Z (MAE value from the compare_forecast_actual output).

Many target intervals in the 2026-07-30T11:00:00Z to 2026-07-30T23:00:00Z slice lacked provably-public actuals by 2026-07-30T14:35:00Z and therefore were not paired with forecasts for error calculation (as reported by compare_forecast_actual).
AEMO market notices retrieved for SA1 in the surrounding window include a Forecast LOR1 notice and its subsequent cancellation; those notices are quoted under published_findings below [c1] [c2].

numeric_claims.text: Mean absolute error (MAE) reported by compare_forecast_actual

possible_explanations.statement: The forecast POE50 of 1525.0 MW may reflect model input assumptions such as rooftop PV and other generation/consumption inputs used by the forecasting system; comparing the forecast model inputs (for example the ROOFTOP_PV_FORECAST table) and contemporaneous weather forecasts would test this.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain the forecasting-system input files used by PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202607302200_20260730213147 (e.g. rooftop PV forecasts and temperature inputs) and compare those inputs to observed generation and weather for the interval ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: The reported MAE of 2.0 MW might indicate close agreement for the single paired interval(s) available by the as_of time; checking additional paired intervals once more actuals become provably public would test whether this low MAE generalises.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Re-run compare_forecast_actual after more actual operational demand intervals become provably public and compare the MAE across the fuller set of paired targets.
